Oxford 3 Speed City Bikes
Classic, Stylish, Comfortable, Sweet and simple, low-maintenance Shimano Nexus 3 speed town and city bikes. Super-efficient road-worthy tires; wide enough for softening most town bumps. Components and geometry with a most comfy position. Cruise back to school on campus, town or neighborhood. Finely Hand Crafted of durable, comfortable 4130 CroMo Steel. Stylish custom color matched fenders, color-matched chain-guard, brown stitched grips and matching brown saddle.
